venue.title: A Window on Tempo, from tap to payout
venue.subtitle: Your passkey or a capped key signs; ops keeps the clock and the prints moving; the engine decides and pays.
venue.note: Tempo testnet (Moderato) with testnet pathUSD. Live checks are dated in Evidence. The relay and the keepers are Mitoshi's servers: they can stall, but they cannot move your money or change a result.

nodes.title: Passkey account
nodes.subtitle: WebAuthn, verified by Tempo
nodes.detail: Sign-up creates a passkey; your Tempo account comes from it, and Tempo checks its WebAuthn signatures natively. Mitoshi keeps only the public key and the credential id.
nodes.authority: Only your passkey withdraws, revokes keys or changes the account.

nodes.title: One-tap key or grant
nodes.subtitle: Access key · Trading Balance SESSION
nodes.detail: Either an access key limited to the engine and pathUSD approvals, with a daily dollar limit and a 24-hour expiry, or a SESSION grant on your Trading Balance with per-tap and daily caps.
nodes.authority: Can buy and close inside its caps. Never withdraws, never sends money elsewhere.

nodes.title: The relay
nodes.subtitle: /api/relay, fee sponsorship
nodes.detail: Co-signs as the fee payer for calls its per-contract policies allow, inside budgets kept in Postgres, and stops when the fee payer's balance runs low.
nodes.authority: Pays network fees. It cannot change a call or spend from your account.

nodes.title: EventsEngine
nodes.subtitle: placeOrder, immediate-or-cancel
nodes.detail: Each Window has its own on-chain order book. A tap takes what rests on the book, immediate-or-cancel, and the position lands in the same transaction.
nodes.authority: No function takes a payout address. The engine checks price, size and the Window's state on every order.

nodes.title: Window roller
nodes.subtitle: 66 series, one clock
nodes.detail: Opens the next Window of each series: BTC, ETH and SOL every five minutes, nine stocks at 5, 15 and 60 minutes in NYSE hours and on RedStone's 24/7 feeds, and the weekend Gap.
nodes.authority: Holds the roller role: lists Windows. It cannot price, resolve or pay.

nodes.title: Price relay
nodes.subtitle: RedStone packages on chain
nodes.detail: Fetches RedStone's signed data packages for each Window's open and close and posts them to the engine. A separate archive actor keeps RedStone's packages for every boundary.
nodes.authority: Anyone may post a package; only the verifier decides whether it counts.

nodes.title: Print verifier
nodes.subtitle: 3 of 5 signers, near the boundary
nodes.detail: RedStonePrintVerifier recovers the signers of each package on chain and admits a print only with at least three of RedStone's five production signers, close enough to the Window's boundary.
nodes.authority: Refuses a package short of signers or off the boundary. No operator override.

nodes.title: Settler
nodes.subtitle: settle · void · redeemFor
nodes.detail: Once both prints are in, it settles the Window; with no print by the deadline it voids it at half. Then it pays each winning position to its owner.
nodes.authority: Settling is permissionless and pays only by the recorded prints.

nodes.title: Indexer
nodes.subtitle: Engine, vaults, strategies
nodes.detail: Follows the engine, the three Trading Balance vaults, the strategy registry and ERC-8004 feedback into Postgres, block by block, with a live cursor.
nodes.authority: Read-only on chain. It cannot change a result.

nodes.title: Recount
nodes.subtitle: Replay against the index
nodes.detail: Replays the engine's and the vaults' logs and compares every total with the index, Window by Window; the S5 gate passed with stats equal to the recount.
nodes.authority: A check, not a source: a mismatch is a finding.

nodes.title: The app's reads
nodes.subtitle: Index, EngineLens, the stream
nodes.detail: Markets, Portfolio, Stats and the leaderboard read the index and the engine's lens; prices and fills reach the terminal over one live stream.
nodes.authority: A page is a view of chain evidence; the transaction is the receipt.

nodes.title: Proof page
nodes.subtitle: Re-verify in your browser
nodes.detail: Reads the print's transaction from Tempo, takes the signed packages out of it and asks the on-chain verifier for the price, then compares it with what the engine recorded.
nodes.authority: Nothing in that check comes from Mitoshi's servers.

exits.title: Exits that run with the app closed
exits.subtitle: You grant a sell-only permission once; the keeper decides when; the vault decides the lowest price.
exits.note: Live on Moderato since 2026-10-09: a stop-loss sold by the keeper 20.6 s after it triggered, with the tab closed. An exit fills only against a bid that is there.

nodes.title: Trading Balance
nodes.subtitle: EventVaultV2, yours alone
nodes.detail: A vault you own on Tempo that holds money and positions for you. Deposits and withdrawals are yours; proceeds of every sale land back in it.
nodes.authority: Only the owner withdraws. Intake is never fee-sponsored.

nodes.title: EXIT grant
nodes.subtitle: One biometric, sell-only
nodes.detail: Names Mitoshi's keeper as the actor that may sell positions this Trading Balance holds. No budget, no buys, no withdrawals; it lasts 30 days.
nodes.authority: placeFor refuses it. It can only sell through exitFor, at or above the floor.

nodes.title: Your trigger
nodes.subtitle: Take-profit · stop-loss · trail
nodes.detail: Set from the terminal on what CLOSE pays. A trail arms once the price is the trailing distance past break-even and only moves your way.
nodes.authority: The keeper refuses a trigger on a grant that is not yours.

nodes.title: Stop
nodes.subtitle: Settings → revoke on chain
nodes.detail: Every key and grant is listed in Settings; Stop revokes it in one transaction the relay pays for.
nodes.authority: Revocation is the owner's alone and takes effect on chain.

nodes.title: exit-keeper
nodes.subtitle: Ops actor, keeper role
nodes.detail: Watches every armed trigger on the live feed and the Window's book, with or without your tab open; an armed trail survives an ops restart.
nodes.authority: Decides when to sell. It cannot buy, withdraw or sell below the floor.

nodes.title: Fair-value floor
nodes.subtitle: FairValueGuard at a signed spot
nodes.detail: The sale's limit must be at or above the Window's fair value at a signed RedStone spot, less the wider of 15 % of it or 10¢ — the allowance the app grants; the contract caps them at 20 % and 15¢.
nodes.authority: Enforced by the vault on every exitFor, from a signed proof, never a preview.

nodes.title: exitFor
nodes.subtitle: Sell into the Window's book
nodes.detail: Sells the position immediate-or-cancel into the book at the limit. If no bid meets the floor, nothing fills and the keeper tries again rather than sell lower.
nodes.authority: A sale under the floor reverts BelowFairFloor.

nodes.title: Proceeds
nodes.subtitle: Back to the Trading Balance
nodes.detail: What the sale fetched lands in the owner's Trading Balance, as every sale's proceeds do. The terminal shows a sale made with the app closed on the next visit.
nodes.authority: Money never leaves the owner's vault account.

nodes.title: House maker
nodes.subtitle: seed-maker
nodes.detail: Quotes both sides of every live Window around the fair value carried by its measured basis, with one-transaction requotes.
nodes.authority: Its quotes are real orders: they can be taken or not.

nodes.title: Exit tail
nodes.subtitle: Both sides to lock − 30 s
nodes.detail: The house keeps its exit side quoted until about 30 seconds before a Window locks: half size from lock − 61 s, nothing new from lock − 45 s.
nodes.authority: A promise of the house's quoting, not a guarantee of a fill.

nodes.title: Maker vault
nodes.subtitle: Earn's depth
nodes.detail: The maker vault quotes the crypto Windows with its suppliers' money; Range, Moonshot and Parlay price against that rested depth.
nodes.authority: Suppliers carry its inventory risk; the vault's admin can pause new supply only.

nodes.title: Settlement
nodes.subtitle: If nothing sold
nodes.detail: A position no exit sold settles like any other: $1 a winning contract, nothing a losing one, half on a void.
nodes.authority: Settled by the recorded prints only.

stocks.title: Stocks on Tempo
stocks.subtitle: Robinhood Stock Tokens locked on their chain, mirrored on Tempo, traded in guarded pools and themed baskets.
stocks.note: Tempo-side contracts are deployed on Moderato. A LayerZero message from Moderato reached Base Sepolia in 20 s; the way back waits on LayerZero's testnet verifier, and the Robinhood-side lockboxes on testnet ETH (owner action). The bridge, reserves and themes screens are not built yet.

nodes.title: Stock Token
nodes.subtitle: Robinhood's own ERC-20
nodes.detail: The real tokenized share on Robinhood Chain, with its UI multiplier for splits and dividends (ERC-8056).
nodes.authority: Robinhood's token: its pauses and policies apply.

nodes.title: StockLockbox
nodes.subtitle: OFT adapter, immutable
nodes.detail: Locks the token to send it, releases it on the way back; one per ticker, with a guardian that can pause new locks but never unlocks.
nodes.authority: A forged over-release reverts and stays stuck — by design.

nodes.title: StockSyncSender
nodes.subtitle: Multiplier and status
nodes.detail: Anyone can sync a token's multiplier, pending change and pause flags to Tempo as a full snapshot.
nodes.authority: Reads Robinhood's contracts; writes nothing there.

nodes.title: Testnet hop
nodes.subtitle: Base Sepolia transit
nodes.detail: On testnet LayerZero has no direct Robinhood ↔ Tempo path, so a transit OFT and a composer on Base Sepolia forward each send and each sync.
nodes.authority: Holds tokens only in flight; an underfunded hop waits and can be retried.

nodes.title: Mint/burn adapter
nodes.subtitle: TIP20MintBurnAdapter
nodes.detail: Mints the mirror on arrival and burns it on the way out. A mint the token would refuse (pause, policy, cap, receive policy) is deferred and claimable, never lost.
nodes.authority: The only issuer of its mirror. Upgradeable behind a proxy: on testnet its admin is the deployer key; a Safe is planned for mainnet.

nodes.title: Mirror TIP-20
nodes.subtitle: bTSLA, bAMZN, bPLTR, bNFLX, bAMD
nodes.detail: A Tempo-native token per share, with a supply cap, and a ScaledUIView that shows balances in shares after the multiplier.
nodes.authority: Supply moves only by the adapter's mint and burn.

nodes.title: StockReference
nodes.subtitle: The share's price
nodes.detail: Takes RedStone payloads (three of five signers) and Chainlink Data Streams reports where credentials exist (not on testnet yet); a keeper flag carries the market session.
nodes.authority: Permissionless writes; only newer verified prices count.

nodes.title: StockGuardHook
nodes.subtitle: Uniswap v4, flags 0x20C0
nodes.detail: Keeps every guarded pathUSD pool inside a band around the reference: refuses swaps when halted, paused, unsynced or stale, and checks the price after every swap.
nodes.authority: Never blocks adding or removing liquidity, so exits stay open.

nodes.title: Stock pools
nodes.subtitle: pathUSD / mirror, 0.3 %
nodes.detail: Four pools initialized with house liquidity ladders (TSLA, AMZN, PLTR, AMD); NFLX is registered and not initialized.
nodes.authority: Ordinary v4 pools behind the guard.

nodes.title: Themes
nodes.subtitle: ThemeRegistry · ThemeRouter
nodes.detail: A theme is a basket a creator publishes. Following it authorizes an access key for the theme's agent, scoped to the router with a daily limit per token; the agent's rebalances buy through the guarded pools.
nodes.authority: The key can only call the router and approve tokens to it; any other approval is refused on chain.

nodes.title: Reserves
nodes.subtitle: Locked there, supply here
nodes.detail: Each lockbox's outstanding balance per destination against the mirror's supply on Tempo: the proof every mirror is backed.
nodes.authority: A read of both chains, not a promise.

nodes.title: Stock Windows
nodes.subtitle: Live today
nodes.detail: Separately, the prediction market already trades nine stocks' prices in Windows settled on RedStone; no token is needed for that.
nodes.authority: Settled by the engine like every Window.
